newsitem.title: USA: Webster says two acquisitions closing Q3.
newsitem.headline: Webster says two acquisitions closing Q3.

text.p: Webster Financial Corp, the holding company for Webster Bank, said Thursday it expects to close its acquisition of People's Savings Financial Corp and Sachem Trust N.A. in the third quarter of the year.
People's Savings is the holding company for New Britain, Conn.,-based People's Savings Bank & Trust, which has total assets of $482 million and $327 million in trust assets under management.
Sachem, of Guilford, Conn., has more than $300 million in trust assets.
The trust operations of the two companies are expected to be merged into a Webster Bank, it said.
